philosophy.title: Business Philosophy
philosophy.body: Your business isn't a template. Technology should fit the way you sell, operate, and grow — with systems that stay clear, reliable, and ready to evolve.

intro.title: Our Story
intro.body: CoreVia wasn't a straight line. Before writing a single line of code for a client, I spent years building things in very different worlds — and every one of them shaped how I build software today.

military.title: Military
military.body: I served as a Communications Support System Specialist, Sergeant and Squad Leader — responsible for bringing technical solutions to different users and teams, and making sure their systems actually worked, under real pressure. That's where I learned discipline, and what it means to be accountable for something running right, not just looking right.

filmmaking.title: Filmmaking & Real Estate
filmmaking.body: After that, I stepped away from tech for a while — into filmmaking and real estate investing. Filmmaking sharpened my eye for how things should look and feel, polished and intentional. Real estate taught me how small businesses actually think about money, risk, and growth — the same instincts I bring to every client conversation now.

return.title: The Return
return.body: In 2026, I came back to technology — this time to build CoreVia. Everything before it wasn't a detour. It was preparation: the discipline to make systems work, the eye to make them look right, and the understanding of what business owners actually need to grow.

howWeWork.title: How We Work With Clients
howWeWork.description: Every project gets direct attention from start to finish. No handoffs. No account management layer. You stay in touch with the person building your software — the same commitment from first conversation through delivery.

differentiate.title: What Sets CoreVia Apart
differentiate.body: Founder-led delivery, product craft across software and content, and tools chosen for speed, reliability, and room to scale — without burying you under process.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: CoreVia (“we,” “us,” “our”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.body: When you submit an inquiry through our contact form, we collect: your name, phone number, email address, business name (if provided), and any details you share about your project needs.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use this information solely to respond to your inquiry, discuss your project, and provide a quote. We do not sell, rent, or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

retention.heading: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain inquiry information for as long as needed to respond to your request and maintain a record of our business communications. If you’d like your information removed, contact us directly.

clientPlatforms.heading: Client Software Platforms
clientPlatforms.body: This policy covers information collected through this website only. If you become a client, the software platform we build for your business (including any data stored within it) is governed by a separate service agreement established directly with you, not by this policy.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this policy can be directed to us via the contact form on this site or through WhatsApp.

meta.title: Terms of Service
meta.description: Terms governing use of the Corevia website, including warranty and liability information.

use.heading: Use of This Website
use.body: This website provides information about CoreVia’s software development services. By using this site, you agree not to misuse it, attempt unauthorized access, or use its content for purposes other than evaluating our services.

pricing.heading: No Public Pricing
pricing.body: Pricing, project scope, and engagement terms are determined individually per client based on submitted requirements. Nothing on this website constitutes a binding quote or offer — pricing is provided only after direct communication and is documented in a separate agreement.

warranty.heading: 30-Day Warranty
warranty.body: Once a project is delivered, CoreVia provides a 30-day warranty period during which we will address and resolve issues, bugs, or requested adjustments that fall within the original agreed scope of work, at no additional cost. Requests outside the original scope may be treated as new work and quoted separately.

ownership.heading: Content Ownership
ownership.body: All content on this website (text, images, branding) is the property of CoreVia unless otherwise noted, and may not be reproduced without permission.

noWarranty.heading: No Warranty
noWarranty.body: This website is provided “as is.” While we strive for accuracy, we make no guarantees regarding the completeness or timeliness of information presented here.

liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: CoreVia is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of this website. Services rendered to clients are governed by separately executed agreements, not by these terms.

changes.heading: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms can be directed to us via the contact form on this site or through WhatsApp.
